market_summary: All three assets (EURUSD, GBPUSD, BTCUSD) are exhibiting heavy downward momentum during the London/NY Overlap, trading well below their respective session VWAPs, EMA50 baselines, and Value Area Lows. However, all three are currently extended beneath their -2 ATR lower envelopes and pressing directly against key session low supports without fresh breakout volume spikes. Chasing shorts at current levels poses heightened mean-reversion risk, making HOLD the disciplined posture across the board.

GEX is null. Due to being extended past the lower ATR band right into Session Low support without immediate volume confirmation, action is HOLD.
